info.title: Raspberry Pi OEE/RCA Gateway HTTP API
info.summary: Frozen v1 integration surface for process context, quality events, OEE, and RCA.
info.description: The Gateway is an analysis and process-context service for one line and station. It is not the MES delivery authority. QA/MES clients use POST /v1/quality-events with sourceEventId as the idempotency key. Additive optional response fields are allowed in v1; removals and breaking semantic changes require a new major path. See docs/API-CONTRACT.md.

servers.description: Default loopback listener. Remote access must use the approved TLS reverse proxy.

tags.name: Context
tags.description: Process-context events and the active work context.

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: OEE decomposition and explainable RCA candidates.

get.description: This endpoint is deliberately public so a local supervisor can probe process health without a bearer token.

200.description: Current health, storage, clock, PLC diagnostics, and sequence watermarks.
Current work-order context used for new events and default analytics scope.

post.description: Included fields are replaced; null or an empty string clears a field. The server restores the previous in-memory context and returns 503 if durable persistence fails.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return at most this many of the newest matching events.

200.description: Matching alarms, including events raised between sampling ticks.

parameters.name: ngCount
parameters.description: Explicit NG quantity. When omitted, recorded quality events are used.

200.description: OEE values, time basis, counter mode, loss breakdown, and data-quality diagnostics.

post.summary: Durably record an NG quality event
post.description: sourceEventId is the idempotency key. A first accepted write returns 201. Repeating the same sourceEventId returns 200 with duplicate=true and the retained event. A 503 means the event was not accepted; resolve storage and retry with the same sourceEventId.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an already retained sourceEventId.

post.summary: Find explainable RCA candidates around a target
post.description: Candidates are time-window correlations and never causal claims. Supply qualityEventId to target a retained NG event, or targetAt for a time target.

200.description: RCA candidates, scope, raw evidence, and the non-causation disclaimer.

post.description: Legacy convenience endpoint. New clients should use POST /v1/work-context. A null value clears the active correlation ID.

200.description: The active correlation ID after the update.

bearerAuth.description: Required when GATEWAY_API_TOKEN is configured. The token is supplied out of band and must not be placed in URLs or logs.

BadRequest.description: Malformed JSON, invalid field value, or invalid integer query parameter.

Unauthorized.description: Bearer token missing or invalid. The response includes WWW-Authenticate: Bearer.

NotFound.description: The requested resource or referenced quality event does not exist.

StorageUnavailable.description: The write was not durably accepted. Resolve storage health and retry. Quality callers must reuse the same sourceEventId.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server-side failure. The error message is diagnostic and must not be treated as a stable machine-readable code.

HealthStatus.summary: Healthy Gateway with synchronized PLC and clock

basis.plannedTime: intersection of sampled window and configured shift windows
basis.availability: RUNNING planned intervals / available planned intervals after planned downtime and changeover
basis.performance: goodCount delta / theoretical good units at nominal output
basis.lossBreakdown: planned stops, planned downtime, changeover, unplanned/unknown stops, speed loss, and quality loss

candidates.title: Temperature anomaly

evidence.detail: temperature 92.00 C reached/exceeded the 70 C threshold

value.disclaimer: Candidates are derived from time-window overlap. They are not evidence of causation and require human confirmation.
